crossRefs.note: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’ ”

translations.web: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”
translations.bsb: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people.”
translations.kjv: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
translations.asv: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereof, he shall be cut off from his people.
